headline: Heat Pumps in Sacramento: SMUD Rebates, Running Costs and Tips From a Local Contractor
subheading: Jairo Gonzalez, owner of Hella Comfort Heating & Air, has installed heat pumps around Sacramento for 16 years. He explains the $3,000 SMUD rebate, why inverter heat pumps cost less to run than gas, and the install mistakes homeowners should avoid.
seoTitle: Sacramento Heat Pumps: SMUD Rebates and Contractor Tips
description: A Sacramento HVAC contractor explains the SMUD heat pump rebate (up to $3,000), running costs vs gas, ducted vs mini-split, and install mistakes to avoid.
